verdict.rationale: Ardent documents a REST API aimed at CI systems, internal platforms, custom dashboards and agent workflows. It reaches fine-grained operations such as connector deletion locks and quarantine release, and has role-scoped tokens for automation. The CLI adds JSON output, stable error codes and token-only auth. Nothing in the pack explicitly claims the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and no OpenAPI spec could be found at any probed path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and evidence of API coverage across branches, projects, settings and billing, plus independent hands-on corroboration.
